examples.english: I hate being at home all the time, especially in winter.

examples.english: You simply need to book a month before you travel.

examples.english: I hardly moved from the beach all week.
examples.persian: تقریبا تمام هفته از ساحل تکان نخوردم.

examples.english: I would recommend the area, but not necessarily that hotel.

examples.english: He shouted at me angrily when I refused to move my car.
